name: Nunchaku Sausages
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist/investigator 1, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 1, bard/skald 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target a string of sausages
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

You enchant a string of raw sausages to become a weapon with all the properties of a masterwork nunchaku. You are considered proficient with nunchaku for the spell’s duration.

At 5th level, the nunchaku sausages gain a +1 enhancement bonus. At 10th level, you may increase the enhancement bonus to +2 or add the brawling, sticky, or throwing weapon property. If the sausages suffer more than 6 points of fire damage, they become cooked and the spell ends.
